title: $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ Representation Learning: An Intrinsic Mixed-Curvature Space with Higher Curvature Capacities and Deeper Order-Aware Composition
abstract: arXiv:2609.15083v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixed-curvature representation learning seeks to capture rich geometric structures that cannot be adequately modeled by a single curvature regime. Existing approaches largely rely on product manifolds, which require manually specifying how different curvature spaces are combined and separate their curvature contributions across factors. We introduce the $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ space, a representation geometry defined by the simple $\det(A)=1$ constraint and a left invariant Schatten-$p$ Finsler structure. Despite this minimal construction, $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ exhibits pointwise negative, zero, and positive flag curvature around a common flagpole, while its mixed-curvature and curvature-coupling capacities are asymptotically maximal relative to the intrinsic geometric upper bound. translated_title: $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ 表示学习：一种具有更高曲率容量与更深层次顺序感知组合能力的内在混合曲率空间
translated_abstract: 混合曲率表示学习旨在捕捉单一曲率体系无法充分建模的丰富几何结构。现有方法主要依赖于乘积流形，这需要手动指定不同曲率空间的组合方式，并将曲率贡献分离到各个因子之中。我们提出了 $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ 空间，这是一种由简单的 $\det(A)=1$ 约束和左不变 Schatten-$p$ Finsler 结构定义的表示几何。尽管构造极为简洁，$\mathbb{SL}(n)$ 却能在同一旗杆周围表现出逐点的负、零和正旗曲率，且其混合曲率与曲率耦合容量相对于内在几何上界渐近达到最大值。除几何特性外，其非交换群结构提供了固有的顺序敏感性，其非幂零李代数允许在任意深度处存在非零的嵌套李括号。
tldr: 本文提出由行列式约束定义的 $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ 空间作为新型内在混合曲率表示学习几何，无需依赖乘积流形的手动组合设计，即可实现渐近最大的混合曲率容量、固有的顺序敏感性以及任意深度的嵌套组合能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the $\mathbb{SL}(n)$ space, defined by a simple determinant constraint, as an intrinsic mixed-curvature representation geometry that achieves asymptotically maximal curvature capacities, inherent order sensitivity, and arbitrarily deep nested composition without relying on manually designed product manifolds.
